crystal.title: See your map. Carry your clarity.
crystal.sub: Reading reveals the map. Crystal carries the clarity.
crystal.body: A reading helps you see your energy map; a crystal lets you carry that clarity with you.
crystal.bodyWithElement: A reading helps you see your energy map; a crystal lets you carry that clarity with you. If your report points to balancing the “{element}” element, this piece is a classic remedy choice.

reportBazi.title: Read your chart. Carry your remedy.
reportBazi.sub: See the map first, then choose how to balance.
reportBazi.body: A BaZi report outlines your energy map. Pair it with a Five-Element crystal or a gift set to bring insight into daily life.
reportBazi.note: Unlock the full report in the app

reportZiwei.title: Read your stars. Walk with intention.
reportZiwei.sub: Understand the chart, then take the next step.
reportZiwei.body: A Zi Wei report maps the twelve palaces of life. Go deeper with OraSage chat, or pair a crystal bracelet to keep balance close at hand.
reportZiwei.note: View the full chart reading in the app

reportTarot.title: See the pattern. Choose your step.
reportTarot.body: Tarot is not prophecy — it is a doorway to awareness. The cards light the present; the next step stays yours. Daily draws and deep reports work well together.
reportTarot.note: Draw and read inside the app

temple.title: Blessing is connection.
temple.sub: Your support keeps our open BaZi library free.
temple.body: Each blessing is a connection to something larger. Your gift helps keep the OraSage temple experience available for everyone.

ziweiChat.title: Ask deeper. Understand more.
ziweiChat.sub: The follow-up questions often unlock understanding.
ziweiChat.body: After the chart is cast, the questions you ask next are often where understanding grows. OraSage chat moves you from seeing to knowing.
ziweiChat.note: Credits are added to your account automatically

default.title: Clarity first. Action follows.
default.sub: Sometimes you need a listener more than another report.
default.body: Sometimes what you need is not another report, but someone who will listen carefully and help you sort things through. A 30-minute consult focuses on your real question right now.
default.note: An advisor will contact you to confirm the time
